moremax.us.title: Shut In
moremax.us.description: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside. (Thriller) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Man Down
moremax.us.description: When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location. (Thriller, Drama) - 2015

moremax.us.title: Green Zone
moremax.us.description: Chief Warrant Officer Roy Miller and his team of inspectors are on a mission in 2003 to find Iraq's reported stockpiles of weapons of mass destruction. Traveling from one dangerous site to another, Miller and his team fail to find any chemical agents or other weapons. Instead, they discover an elaborate cover-up in which the most-elusive weapon is truth. (Action, Thriller, War) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer

movieplex.us.title: Quartet
movieplex.us.description: Once-popular opera diva Jean Horton (Maggie Smith) creates a stir with her arrival at Beecham House, a home for retired performers. No one feels the uproar more than Reginald (Tom Courtenay), Jean's ex-husband, who still stings from her long-ago infidelity. Most of the other Beecham residents are delighted, and try to convince Jean to join them in a performance of "Rigoletto." Jean, however, knows that she is long past her prime and is reluctant to sully the memory of her once-lovely voice. (Comedy drama) - 2012

movieplex.us.title: Running Free
movieplex.us.description: A troubled boy (Jesse Montgomery-Sythe) staying with his mother befriends a lone wolverine cub in the Alaska wilderness. (Children, Drama) - 1994

movieplex.us.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
movieplex.us.description: Obsessed with cars since childhood, inventor Preston Tucker (Jeff Bridges) has his first successful auto design partnership in the 1930s and designs a successful gun turret for World War II use. With those achievements under his belt, Tucker is determined to create a futuristic car for the masses: the Tucker Torpedo. However, his dreams are challenged by Detroit's auto manufacturers, production problems and accusations of stock fraud, and he is forced to defend his dream and honesty in court. (Biography, Historical drama) - 1988

showtimewomen.us.title: Sliver
showtimewomen.us.description: Well-to-do book editor Carly Norris (Sharon Stone) moves into a luxury apartment building before learning that a number of female tenants have been dying in grisly ways, allegedly at the hands of a serial killer. Soon, Norris becomes romantically involved with one of the prime suspects, building owner Zeke Hawkins (William Baldwin). The other suspect is her neighbor, writer Jack Landsford (Tom Berenger). Unsure of whom to trust, Norris must uncover the truth before she is the next victim. (Thriller) - 1993

showtimenext.us.title: King Kong
showtimenext.us.description: When a research ship is sent to explore an island thought to be rich in oil, paleontologist Jack Prescott sneaks aboard, having heard strange rumors about the island. En route, the crew rescues Dwan, the sole survivor of a shipwreck. When they arrive, they find native people living in fear of a monster called Kong. The natives kidnap Dwan and sacrifice her to what turns out to be an enormous ape. Dwan is eventually rescued, and the ape captured for a gala exhibit. (Adventure, Fantasy) - 1976

showtimenext.us.title: An Unfinished Life
showtimenext.us.description: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds. (Drama) - 2005

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events
skycinemafamily.uk.description: After the three young Baudelaire siblings are left orphaned by a fire in their mansion, they are carted off to live with their distant relative, Count Olaf. Unfortunately, Olaf is a cruel, scheming man only after the inheritance that the eldest Baudelaire, Violet, is set to receive. The children escape and find shelter with their quirky Uncle Monty and, subsequently, their phobic Aunt Josephine, but Olaf is never far behind.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Too
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

skyselect.uk.title: Monster House (2006)
skyselect.uk.description: Young DJ and his pals set out to discover what bloodcurdling secrets lie behind the front door of the scary house across the street. When the house comes alive and starts eating people, have the kids bitten off more than they can chew. - 2006

skyselect.uk.title: Happy Feet (2006)
skyselect.uk.description: Son of Memphis and Norma, little sweet penguin Mumble has a big problem: he can't sing a single note. In a world where everyone needs a heart song to attract a soul mate, Mumble feels he doesn't belong there. Our hero Mumble is the worst singer in the world, but he can tap dance brilliantly. - 2006

skyselect.uk.title: Happy Feet Two (2011)
skyselect.uk.description: Mumble's son Erik hasn't yet found his talents, and he goes with his friends to Adélie-land which is ruled by a penguin who can fly. sonymoviechannel.us.title: Flight of Fury

showtime.us.description: When a giant creature starts destroying Seoul, South Korea, a woman learns that she is somehow connected to the phenomenon. She must now figure out why her seemingly insignificant existence is having such a colossal effect on the fate of the world. (Movies, Comedy) - 2016

showtime.us.title: The November Man
showtime.us.description: An ex-CIA agent (Pierce Brosnan) comes out of retirement to protect a valuable witness (Olga Kurylenko) and soon learns that now he is the target of his former friend and protégé (Luke Bracey). (Movies, Action) - 2014

showtime.us.title: The Intern
showtime.us.description: Dissatisfied with retirement, a 70-year-old widower becomes an intern at an online fashion site and develops a special bond with his young boss. (Movies, Comedy/Drama) - 2015

shoxbetwest.us.title: Love & Basketball
shoxbetwest.us.description: Monica (Sanaa Lathan) and Quincy (Omar Epps) are two childhood friends who both aspire to be professional basketball players. Quincy, whose father, Zeke (Dennis Haysbert), plays for the Los Angeles Clippers, is a natural talent and a born leader. Monica is ferociously competitive but sometimes becomes overly emotional on the court. Over the years, the two begin to fall for each other, but their separate paths to basketball stardom threaten to pull them apart. (Romance, Drama) - 2000

shoxbetwest.us.title: Pretty Red Dress
shoxbetwest.us.description: The story of Travis, Candice and their daughter, Kenisha, and their relationships with the same red dress. (Drama) - 2022

shoxbetwest.us.title: Breathe
shoxbetwest.us.description: Maya and her young daughter, Zora, are forced to live underground when Earth is left uninhabitable due to a lack of oxygen. When a mysterious couple arrive and claim to know the fate of Maya's husband, she tentatively agrees to let them into the bunker. However, mother and daughter soon find themselves in a fight for survival when the truth about the strangers comes to light. (Science fiction, Thriller) - 2024

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Se7en
showtimeshowcase.us.description: When retiring police Detective William Somerset (Morgan Freeman) tackles a final case with the aid of newly transferred David Mills (Brad Pitt), they discover a number of elaborate and grizzly murders. They soon realize they are dealing with a serial killer (Kevin Spacey) who is targeting people he thinks represent one of the seven deadly sins. Somerset also befriends Mills' wife, Tracy (Gwyneth Paltrow), who is pregnant and afraid to raise her child in the crime-riddled city. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Sweet Virginia
showtimeshowcase.us.description: An ex-rodeo rider strikes up a friendship with a young man who may be behind the violence occurring in their small town. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Crimes of the Future
showtimeshowcase.us.description: As the human species adapts to a synthetic environment, the body undergoes new transformations and mutations. Accompanied by his partner, celebrity performance artist Saul Tenser showcases the metamorphosis of his organs.
